tagline: Leading European construction and infrastructure group driving sustainable development
hero_kpi_rationale: No distinctive wow factor identified. Since the construction sector is not exposed to technological waves like AI or cloud computing, CAPEX is retained as the primary KPI as it reflects strategic investments in long-term infrastructure projects, a key driver of the group's growth.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Amount invested annually in infrastructure and construction projects.
kpis.description: ACS group's CAPEX is primarily allocated to infrastructure and construction projects in Europe and Latin America.
kpis.signal: CAPEX growth indicating strengthening of strategic projects

kpis.name: Total headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for ACS group.
kpis.description: The group maintains a high headcount, reflecting its international presence and skilled workforce-based business model.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of work performed, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin is improving slightly thanks to better cost management on job sites.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income relative to total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin is improving thanks to efficiency gains and reduction in overhead expenses.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Revenue of 49.85 billion € in latest year

ai_positioning.summary: ACS shows no mention of artificial intelligence in its communication documents. The company does not appear to be engaged in AI-related initiatives, neither as an internal tool nor as a service offering.
evidence: No mention of AI or related technologies in the document
Absence of terms such as 'artificial intelligence', 'machine learning', 'data analytics' or 'digital transformation'
Exclusive focus on communication, governance and traditional channels
